questions.text: What is the Kazakh name for the snow leopard?
questions.hint: "Known as 'irbis' in Kazakh"

questions.text: The saiga antelope is how old?
questions.hint: "having roamed the Eurasian steppe for more than 2 million years"

questions.text: The steppe eagle's population has grown over the last 50 years.
questions.hint: "declined by more than 90% in the last fifty years"

questions.text: Where is the Caspian seal found?
questions.hint: "found exclusively in the Caspian Sea"

questions.text: The Przewalski's horse was reintroduced to ___ National Park in Kazakhstan.
questions.hint: "in the Altyn Emel National Park in Kazakhstan"

questions.text: How fast can a steppe eagle dive?
questions.hint: "dive at speeds of up to 250 kilometres per hour"

questions.text: The saiga antelope nearly went extinct in the 1990s.
questions.hint: "the species nearly went extinct in the 1990s"

questions.text: How many Caspian seals exist today (approximately)?
questions.hint: "fewer than 100,000 today"

questions.text: How cold does it get in the Altai Mountains in winter?
questions.hint: "Temperatures here drop to minus forty degrees in winter."

questions.text: How does Amir describe minus forty degrees?
questions.hint: "That's absolutely freezing!" (extreme adj + intensifier)

questions.text: How many saiga antelopes are in the herd in the documentary?
questions.hint: "nearly one million animals moving together"

questions.text: After watching the documentary, Amir decides to apply for a conservation internship.
questions.hint: "After this degree, I'm applying for a conservation internship."

questions.text: Zhibek says the saiga herd is "the most ___ thing I've ever watched".
questions.hint: "This is the most spectacular thing I've ever watched."

questions.text: Superlative of "big":
questions.hint: big = short CVC → double consonant + est: the biggest.

questions.text: Superlative of "good":
questions.hint: Irregular: good → the best.

questions.text: "The most tallest mountain" is correct.
questions.hint: Never combine -est AND "most"! → the tallest.

questions.text: The snow leopard is ___ (elusive) predator in Asia.
questions.hint: "elusive" = 3 syllables → the most elusive.

questions.text: Superlative of "heavy":
questions.hint: "heavy" ends in -y → change to -i: the heaviest.

questions.text: Superlative of "bad":
questions.hint: Irregular: bad → the worst.

questions.text: "The steppe is ___ enormous." — which intensifier?
questions.hint: "enormous" is extreme → absolutely enormous.

questions.text: "It was very freezing" is correct English.
questions.hint: "freezing" is extreme → absolutely freezing ✅. Never "very freezing".

questions.text: What is the extreme version of "good"?
questions.hint: good → wonderful, fantastic, superb (extreme versions).

questions.text: "I was ___ amazed by the snow leopard." — correct intensifier:
questions.hint: "amazed" is extreme → completely/totally/absolutely amazed ✅.

questions.text: After the climb, she was ___ (extreme: very tired).
questions.hint: tired → exhausted (extreme). Intensifier: absolutely exhausted.

questions.text: What does "endangered" mean?
opts: At serious risk of becoming extinct
questions.correct: At serious risk of becoming extinct
questions.hint: Endangered = at serious risk of extinction (but not yet extinct).

questions.text: The natural environment where an animal lives is called its ___.
questions.hint: Habitat = the natural home environment of an animal.

questions.text: What is "biodiversity"?
opts: The variety of plants and animals in an area
questions.correct: The variety of plants and animals in an area
questions.hint: Biodiversity = the variety of life (plants, animals, microorganisms) in an area.

questions.text: "Extinct" and "endangered" mean the same thing.
questions.hint: Endangered = at risk; Extinct = completely gone (no members of the species alive).

questions.text: A feature that helps an animal survive in its environment is called a/an:
questions.hint: Adaptation = a feature that helps an animal survive in its specific environment.

questions.text: "Steppe" describes:
opts: A large flat area of grassland with few trees
questions.correct: A large flat area of grassland with few trees
questions.hint: Steppe = a large, flat, treeless or near-treeless grassland.
